changes.description: Integrate the existing Leptos-derived macro source into blog maintenance. Rename the package/library, local dependency paths and generated macro references from xcss_web to blog_ui. Preserve all original MIT copyright and license bytes. Original per-file source receipt is archived unchanged.

Specialize the host macro to the component attribute and typed props constructors used by repository consumers. Retain generic/impl-Trait/lifetime/destructured props, IntoReactiveValue conversions, transparent/untracked execution and IDE error fallback. Retire RSX/template/include-view/island/lazy/server/slot/memo/slice/Params surfaces. Integrate the small literal-extraction helper formerly imported from leptos_hot_reload; preserve source archives and licenses. Move retained component behavior tests to the facade CSR consumer integration test.

Integrate retained CSR implementation modules and compiler helpers as recorded in INTEGRATED-SOURCES.json. Preserve earlier provenance and original licenses. Component names use an independently implemented Unicode-aware conversion; discarded implementations are explicitly retired in the append-only migration ledger.

integrated_sources.changes: Keep literal matching behavior; replace redundant match &value with match value. Original archive and hashes are unchanged.
